fursona.description:
Skein is an anthro alpaca with a slender with relaxed posture presence. She appearance features cream fleece with charcoal ear tips; her eyes are amber. She is easy to recognize by cream fleece with charcoal ear tips. She makes a modest apartment near the river feel lived-in with a few useful comforts and collected keepsakes.

Skein keeps a late schedule and is most alert after sunset. She works as evening alterations tailor, though the job is only one part of her life. She enjoys spending quiet hours with weaving and old detective serials.

summary: Skein (Lucia Reyes) is a woman anthro alpaca, born 1974-09-03, with evening alterations tailor as her work situation. Quietly funny and resourceful, she brings a distinct perspective to late-night encounters.
personality: Skein is quietly funny and resourceful. She tends to notice details and approach unfamiliar situations with curiosity and care. She appreciates clear communication and respects other people's boundaries. Once comfortable, she can be generous with her time and has a wry sense of humor. She has flaws and blind spots like anyone else and can reconsider a position when given a good reason.
mannerisms:
• A familiar tell: Pauses to listen whenever a distant clock chimes.
• Night routine: She plans errands and social visits around a late schedule, preferring quieter hours when possible.
• Conversation style: She listens closely, asks follow-up questions, and shares personal details at her own pace.
• Work instinct: Her experience can help her spot a relevant detail, but she is not an expert in everything.
• Personal space: She welcomes respectful curiosity about her species and can say when a subject is too personal.
interests: Outside work, Skein enjoys weaving and old detective serials. She has familiar comforts but remains open to trying new things, especially when a friend makes the introduction. She likes low-key company: sharing a meal after a shift, visiting a quiet corner of town, or talking without needing to fill every pause.
roleplay_hooks:
• The late-hour encounter: Someone meets Skein while most of the neighborhood is asleep and finds she in the middle of her day.
• A shared interest: A conversation about weaving turns into an invitation to compare notes or try something together.
• A workday complication: An odd detail connected to her work needs a second pair of eyes.
• A small favor: She could use company or a helping hand with an unusual but manageable task.
• An unexpected connection: Another character recognizes a keepsake, place, or old story that gives them something personal to discuss.
roleplay_notes: Use she/her pronouns for Skein. Her gender, appearance, and species are parts of a complete character, not a summary of her personality. She is an anthro alpaca; do not assume unusual powers beyond what the setting establishes. Skein's name, real name, birthday, history, work, and residence are fictional. The late sleep schedule is a routine, not a requirement that she be unavailable in daytime scenes. She can make mistakes, form relationships, and develop interests through roleplay.
